scripts.build: bun build src/bin.ts --outfile dist/bin.js --target bun --format esm --sourcemap=inline && bun build src/bin.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --minify --sourcemap --outfile bin/ccs
scripts.install:local: ln -sf "$PWD/bin/ccs" "$HOME/.bun/bin/ccs" 2>/dev/null || ln -sf "$PWD/bin/ccs" "$HOME/.local/bin/ccs" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Add $(pwd)/bin to your PATH'
